title: One image, three registries
summary: One multi-stage build produces one distroless image, which is tagged by version and commit and pushed unchanged to Docker Hub, Azure Container Registry and Amazon ECR. Two scanners check it.

components.name: Multi-stage build
components.note: Stage 1 installs from the lockfile and builds the client and an esbuild server bundle. Stage 2 copies only dist and server.mjs onto a distroless nonroot Node 24 base. Version and commit SHA come from package.json and git, never typed by hand.

components.name: Runtime image
components.note: No node_modules, no shell, no package manager. The health check calls node directly. SIGTERM is handled, so docker stop exits 0 in about 0.2 s.
